title: Feather pitches a $30,000 humanoid platform to developers
teaser: Feather Robotics is building a modular humanoid-robot platform for developers, rather than trying to win the race to a single general-purpose machine. The startup has already sold robots for restaurant food preparation in Japan and laboratory cleaning, generating more than $1 million in revenue. Its larger bet is that robotics will need an open hardware-and-software layer before the industry reaches its “ChatGPT moment”—if that moment arrives soon at all.
